reason: The hypothesis directly restates the screw-to-edge dislocation transition mechanism and the resulting yield strength plateau that are already reported as findings or proposed mechanisms in P5, P11, P13, P16, P17, P42, and P47. It applies this known mechanism to the HfNbTaTiZr alloy, but the core idea, mechanism, and predicted outcome are taken from the literature without substantive new integration or justification.
copied_elements: plateau in yield strength at elevated temperatures
edge dislocation dominance at high temperature
in situ neutron diffraction and TEM characterization
